title: TCG: Paldea Evolved
description: Test your knowledge of the second SV expansion!

questions.question: When was Paldea Evolved released?
questions.explanation: Paldea Evolved launched June 9, 2023 as the second SV expansion.

questions.question: Which final evolution of the grass starter is featured as ex in Paldea Evolved?
questions.explanation: Meowscarada ex, the final form of Sprigatito, debuts in Paldea Evolved.

questions.question: Paldea Evolved features the fully evolved Paldean starters.
questions.explanation: Meowscarada ex, Skeledirge ex, and Quaquaval ex all appear in this set.

questions.question: Which legendary Pokémon ex headlines Paldea Evolved?
questions.explanation: Chien-Pao ex from the Treasures of Ruin became a competitive standout.

questions.question: Iono debuted as a Supporter card in Paldea Evolved.
questions.explanation: Iono debuted in the Paldea Evolved expansion as one of its highlight Supporter cards.

questions.question: Which gym leader's signature Pokémon Tinkaton appears in this set?

options.text: Tinkaton has no specific gym leader; it's a wild Pokémon

questions.explanation: Tinkaton is a wild Paldean Pokémon, not a gym leader signature.

questions.question: How many cards does the Paldea Evolved set contain?
questions.explanation: Paldea Evolved has 279 cards including secret rares.

questions.question: Gardevoir ex from Paldea Evolved became a top-tier competitive deck.
questions.explanation: Gardevoir ex's Psychic Embrace ability defined the Standard format for over a year.

questions.question: Which Special Illustration Rare Supporter became one of the most desired pulls?
questions.explanation: Iono's SIR became one of the most popular and pricey chase cards.

questions.question: Paldea Evolved continued the Tera Pokémon ex mechanic from the base set.
questions.explanation: Tera Pokémon ex cards continued to appear, including Tera-type ex versions.
